card.title: I. STRIDSGRUPPEN
card.text: Has +2 attack against units with higher attack.
card.flavorText: The I. Stridsgruppen was an infantry battalion of the Swedish Volunteer Corps (Swedish: Svenska frivilligkåren) which consisted of 9,640 officers and men. Despite Sweden having declared itself "non-belligerent" during the conflict, the Corps was utilized by Finland and actively engaged in combat. These Swedish volunteers fought on the front lines and encountered significant casualties during the Battle of Salla (30 November 1939 – 13 March 1940): 33 dead, 10 missing, 50 wounded, and 130 disabled due to frostbite. Additionally, the Swedish Voluntary Air Force, F19, deployed 25 aircraft, while volunteers defended Turku with an anti-aircraft battery. By the war's end, the Volunteer Corps comprised 8,260 Swedes, along with 725 Norwegians and 600 Danes, showcasing a strong Nordic unity reflected in their emblem, the "four brother hands," symbolizing Finland, Sweden, Norway, and Denmark.
